name: Web Access
description: Web search, page and image fetching, stored-content retrieval, source checks, page answers, field extraction, and authenticated fetches for the agent, ported from the pi-web-access extension.
author: PI-Desktop port of nicobailon/pi-web-access

agentTools.name: web_search
agentTools.description: Search the web for sources or answers. Full results are stored for retrieval with get_search_content by responseId. Prefer 2-4 varied queries.

provider.description: auto, all, a name, or a list of names searched together; omit for the configured default.

proxy.description: Proxy URL; omit by default; "" forces direct

model.description: Override the search model for this call as "provider/id" (for example "openai/gpt-4.1-mini"). Only providers that accept an override honour it.

agentTools.name: fetch_content
agentTools.description: Fetch web pages, PDFs, GitHub repos, images, and videos. Full content is stored for retrieval with get_search_content by responseId.

mode.description: readable (default): extract readable content as markdown. raw: return the exact textual body using direct HTTP only. answer: answer `prompt` from the fetched page and return the answer instead of the page. extract: pull `fields` out of each fetched page.

forceClone.description: Clone GitHub repos over the size limit

proxy.description: Proxy URL; omit by default; "" forces direct

prompt.description: answer: the question to answer from the page. Video analysis: the instruction for the frames.

answerModel.description: answer: model as "provider/model-id". Defaults to the session model; requires mode answer.

timestamp.description: Video: where to start, for example "90" or "1:30".

frames.description: Video: frames to sample. Used when timestamp is set or frames is above 1.

model.description: Video: model as "provider/model-id" used to analyse the sampled frames.

auth.description: Send browser cookies read from the named auth profile; true uses the default profile. Refused with mode answer or extract.

redirects.description: Refuse a redirect that leaves the origin.

fields.description: extract: field name to type, where type is text, number, date, time, datetime, or duration. 1 to 16 fields; requires mode extract.

agentTools.name: get_search_content
agentTools.description: Page through or search stored content from web_search, source_check, or fetch_content by responseId.

agentTools.name: source_check
agentTools.description: Gather cited web passages about a claim for manual review.

fetchContent.description: Fetch top 5 pages for exact passages

provider.description: auto, all, a name, or a list of names searched together; omit for the configured default.

proxy.description: Proxy URL; omit by default; "" forces direct

settings.title: 默认搜索供应商
settings.description: auto 表示自动选择，all 表示把全部可用供应商一起搜，也可填单个供应商名。各家的密钥在「联网访问」面板里填。

settings.title: 搜索后自动总结
settings.description: 打开后会用当前会话模型把搜索结果总结成一段带链接的说明。每次总结会多花一次补全，所以默认关闭。

settings.title: 默认抓取模式
settings.description: readable 提取正文，raw 返回原始文本，answer 用会话模型回答页面问题，extract 按字段抽取（需要在调用时提供 fields）。

settings.title: 允许的抓取模式
settings.description: 用英文逗号分隔，元素取自 readable、raw、answer、extract。extract 会把页面正文发给 Cloudflare，上游默认不含它；加上才允许字段抽取。

settings.title: 内联内容字符上限
settings.description: 搜索摘要与已存页面共用的输出长度上限。小于 1000 时按上游默认 30000 处理，最大 200000。

settings.title: 代理
settings.description: 抓取网页与调用供应商时使用的代理地址；留空表示直连。

en.name: Web Access
en.description: Web search, page and image fetching, stored-content retrieval, source checks, page answers, field extraction, and authenticated fetches for the agent, ported from the pi-web-access extension.
en.safetyNotes: Runs the upstream pi-web-access modules unchanged inside the plugin process and calls the open web on the agent's behalf. net.anyHost is declared because a web-access tool must reach whatever host a search provider or a user-supplied URL resolves to. agent.prompt.inject ships one skill that tells the model how to use the tools; it is instructions, not code. agent.complete spends your model quota for fetch_content mode answer, only when you ask for that mode. keyboard.globalShortcut binds Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Y to open this plugin's own panel command. shell.openExternal opens a stored result link you click. Provider credentials are written only to this plugin's private data directory and never logged. No telemetry.

zh-CN.name: 联网访问
zh-CN.description: 把 pi-web-access 扩展的联网搜索、网页与图片抓取、结果检索、来源核查、页面问答、字段提取与带登录态抓取能力搬给 Agent。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 在插件进程内运行未改动的上游 pi-web-access 模块，并代表 Agent 访问公网。声明 net.anyHost 是因为联网工具必须能访问搜索供应商或用户给出 URL 所在的任意主机。agent.prompt.inject 只提供一份说明如何选用工具的技能文档，是指令不是代码。agent.complete 会在你主动使用 fetch_content 的 answer 模式时消耗你的模型额度。keyboard.globalShortcut 把 Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Y 绑定到本插件自己的面板命令。shell.openExternal 用于打开你点击的已存结果链接。供应商密钥只写入本插件私有数据目录，从不写日志。无遥测。

safetyNotes: Runs the upstream pi-web-access modules unchanged and calls the open web on the agent's behalf. net.anyHost is required because provider endpoints and user-supplied URLs are open-world. agent.prompt.inject contributes one instruction skill, agent.complete backs fetch_content mode answer, keyboard.globalShortcut binds one panel command, and shell.openExternal opens a result link the user clicks. Credentials stay in the plugin data directory and are never logged.
